attempts.summary: Installed python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock on node1 and locked curl at its currently installed version (curl-7.76.1-31.el9). Verified the lock survives a real full-system dnf update (210 packages upgraded, kernel included) and a subsequent node reboot — curl stayed pinned at 7.76.1-31.el9 while a newer curl (7.76.1-40.el9_8.7) was confirmed available upstream and excluded from the transaction.
